<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Town Planning Authority" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_CU" name="Coordination Unit">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>DRAFT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ADD_DATES</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>RECHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SEND</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SO" name="Support Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SUGGEST</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_CM" name="Committee Members">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>DIARIES</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ADVISE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Start of November" />
    <bpmn:task id="DRAFT" name="Draft the schedule of meetings for the next calendar year" />
    <bpmn:task id="ADD_DATES" name="Add draft dates to all calendars" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK" name="Check the dates" />
    <bpmn:task id="SUGGEST" name="Suggest modifications" />
    <bpmn:task id="RECHECK" name="Recheck all dates and look for potential conflicts" />
    <bpmn:task id="SEND" name="Send the final schedule of meeting dates by email to all Committee Members" />
    <bpmn:task id="DIARIES" name="Check the diaries" />
    <bpmn:task id="ADVISE" name="Advise the Coordination Unit of any conflicts" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Schedule confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="DRAFT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="DRAFT" targetRef="ADD_DATES" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="ADD_DATES" targetRef="CHECK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="CHECK" targetRef="SUGGEST" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="SUGGEST" targetRef="RECHECK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="RECHECK" targetRef="SEND" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="SEND" targetRef="DIARIES" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="DIARIES" targetRef="ADVISE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="ADVISE" targetRef="END" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
